note: Role catalog, not running workers. Titles grant no tool or external-action authority. Department members inherit their manager's domain and produce scoped artifacts.

executives.title: Chief Executive Officer
executives.mission: Prioritize company objectives and portfolio outcomes within the owner's mandate.

executives.title: Managing Director / COO
executives.mission: Coordinate delivery, capacity and interdepartment blockers.

executives.title: Chief Technology Officer
executives.mission: Own technical direction, architecture and engineering capability.

executives.title: Chief Product Officer
executives.mission: Own product problems, scope, user value and acceptance criteria.

executives.title: Chief Financial Officer / FinOps
executives.mission: Track estimates, measured resource use and budget trade-offs without initiating spending.

executives.title: Quality Director
executives.mission: Ensure independent review and evidence-based delivery readiness.

executives.title: Chief Information Security Officer
executives.mission: Assess security and privacy risk with independent owner escalation.

executives.title: Growth and Commercial Director
executives.mission: Prepare evidence-based market and commercial work within authorized scope.

departments.title: Product and Business Analysis
departments.mission: Turn goals into testable requirements and product decisions.

departments.title: Research and Innovation
departments.mission: Answer scoped questions with sourced evidence, experiments and explicit uncertainty.

departments.title: UX, UI and Design
departments.mission: Specify usable, accessible user flows and consistent interfaces.

departments.title: Architecture
departments.mission: Define system boundaries and compatible technical contracts.

departments.title: Frontend Engineering
departments.mission: Deliver client behavior against agreed design and API contracts.

departments.title: Backend Engineering
departments.mission: Implement services and business behavior with explicit authorization boundaries.

departments.title: Data and Database
departments.mission: Design schemas and data flows with reproducible quality and rollback evidence.

departments.title: Mobile and Desktop
departments.mission: Deliver platform-specific applications and compatibility evidence.

departments.title: Applied AI and ML
departments.mission: Build and evaluate AI-assisted behavior with explicit data, quality and cost limits.

departments.title: Platform, DevOps and SRE
departments.mission: Make builds, test environments and authorized delivery reproducible and recoverable.

departments.title: Independent Code Review
departments.mission: Review requirements and implementation independently against named revisions.

departments.title: QA and Testing
departments.mission: Verify observable behavior and report defects with reproducible evidence.

departments.title: Security and Privacy
departments.mission: Confirm threats and privacy issues without unauthorized live testing.

departments.title: Project and Program Delivery
departments.mission: Own integrated outcomes, dependencies, milestones and change control.

departments.title: Customer Success and Support
departments.mission: Reproduce reported problems and route incidents and feedback into delivery.

departments.title: Finance and FinOps
departments.mission: Separate estimated, accounted and measured resources and prepare commercial analysis.

departments.title: Growth and Commercial
departments.mission: Prepare sourced opportunity, launch and sales artifacts without unauthorized publication.

departments.title: Agent Operations and Knowledge
departments.mission: Maintain role capability, reusable documentation and fresh project memory.
